main.default_content: This is my cool embed message!

send_confirm.title: 📨 ~ Do you really want to send the message?
send_confirm.description: › This will send the message to the channel {channel}. This action cannot be undone, and perhaps you will be pleased with the work you have created.
send_confirm.mention_permission_warning: `⚠️` ~ **Mention unavailable:** You do not have permission to mention roles—therefore, the role mention will be sent without a notification.
send_confirm.everyone_notice: `🚨` ~ **{users} users will be mentioned:** Your message will mention `@everyone` (or `@here`). Are you sure you want to do this?

webhook.title: 📢 ~ Edit Message Sender
webhook.enabled: `✅` ~ **Status:** `ENABLED` - The message will be sent as `{username}`.
webhook.disabled: `❌` ~ **Status:** `DISABLED` - The message will be sent as `Clank`.
webhook.description: › Set a custom sender name and an optional avatar to send the message using a webhook in this channel, instead of the bot itself.

templates.title: 📁 ~ Embed Templates
templates.description: › Save the current draft of your embeds as a template or load an existing one using the dropdown menu below.

embed_list.title: 🗂️ ~ Manage Embed List
embed_list.description: › Add new embeds, change their order, or remove them. Choose which embed you want to edit using the dropdown menu below.

fields.title: 🧩 ~ Embed Fields
fields.description: › Manage the fields of the currently selected embed. Select a field from the dropdown menu below to edit, move, or delete it.

success.sent: Your beautiful message was sent successfully! <a:check:730387138381873184>

errors.message_not_found: › `❌` - **Message Not Found:** The specified message could not be found in this channel. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.invalid_color: › `❌` - **Invalid Color:** No valid hex code or RGB value was provided. (Use `#5865F2` or `rgb(88,101,242)`) <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.invalid_icon: › `❌` - **Invalid Emoji:** Use a standard emoji or an emoji from this server. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.invalid_timestamp: › `❌` - **Invalid Timestamp:** The entered value is invalid. Use e.g. `10/04/2003 20:00` or `in 2h`. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.invalid_url: › `❌` - **Invalid URL:** No valid URL was recognized. It should start with `https://`. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.template_limit: › `❌` - **Too Many Templates:** A maximum of 25 templates can be saved per server. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.embed_limit: › `❌` - **Too Many Embeds:** A message can contain a maximum of {limit} embeds. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.field_limit: › `❌` - **Too Many Fields:** An embed can contain a maximum of {limit} fields. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.no_template_selected: › `❌` - **No Template Selected:** Select a template from the dropdown before editing it. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.not_own_message: › `❌` - **Cannot Edit:** This message cannot be edited because it was not sent by me. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.nothing_to_send: › `❌` - **Everything is.. empty?** The message has neither content nor an embed - The error has been fixed! Ha! <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.invalid_image: › `❌` - **Invalid Image:** No valid image was recognized. The formats `PNG`, `JPG`, `GIF`, `WEBP`, or `BMP` are currently supported. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.footer_icon_without_text: › `❌` - **Missing Footer Text:** A footer icon also requires text. Add some text or remove the icon! <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.author_fields_without_name: › `❌` - **Missing Author Name:** The URL and profile picture require an author name. Either add a name or remove the other fields. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.url_needs_title_or_description: › `❌` - **Missing Text:** A URL also requires a title or a description. Add one of the two or remove the URL. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.webhook_forbidden: › `❌` - **Missing Bot Permissions:** I lack the permission `MANAGE WEBHOOKS` in {channel} to create a webhook. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.webhook_limit: › `❌` - **Webhook Limit Reached:** The maximum number of webhooks ({limit}) has already been reached in {channel}. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.webhook_invalid: › `❌` - **Invalid Webhook:** The stored webhook could not be found (it was likely deleted) - Set the webhook again. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.bot_permission_missing: › `❌` - **Missing Bot Permissions:** I need the following permissions in {channel}: `{permissions}` <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.user_permission_missing: › `❌` - **Missing Permissions:** You are missing the following permissions in {channel}: `{permissions}` <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
